The farmers allege that fertile farmland is being acquired without their consent or proper gram sabha approval.  **Vivek Khobragade**, leader of the **Azad Samaj Party**, stated that over 6,000 farmers have joined the protest, demanding the cancellation of land acquisition for these projects and immediate measures to address the issue of wild elephants. **Ashish Jaiswal**, co-guardian minister of Gadchiroli, visited the protest site and assured farmers their concerns would be addressed.  **Avishyant Panda**, the Gadchiroli Collector, stated that the land acquisition process provides stakeholders an opportunity to express their reservations but denied claims of misinformation and provocation.

recent_articles.title: In Who-Is-Real-Trinamool Fight, Pushback Planned Against Ritabrata Banerjee
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**'s faction of the **Trinamool Congress** is challenging the Speaker's recognition of **Ritabrata Banerjee** as the new Leader of the Opposition. The faction is also attempting to reintegrate rebel MLAs into the original party fold.  Senior MLA Soven Deb Chatterjee has stated that many rebels are returning to the original Trinamool fold, rejecting **Ritabrata Banerjee**'s list of rebels. Meanwhile, a group of loyalists met at **Mamata Banerjee**'s house and reaffirmed their support for her leadership.

recent_articles.title: NDA And TIPRA Motha Signal Unity During Amit Shah's Tripura Visit
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amit Shah**, **Manik Saha**, and **Pradyot Debbarma** participated in a foundation stone-laying ceremony for the Taj Pushpavanta Palace in Agartala, signaling unity within the BJP-TIPRA Motha alliance despite recent tensions. The event was seen as a message from New Delhi that it remains committed to the partnership despite disagreements over the implementation of the Tiprasa Accord signed in March 2024.  The accord, aimed at addressing issues concerning indigenous people in Tripura, has yet to be fully implemented, leading to frustration among supporters.

recent_articles.title: Somalia declares order restored after two days of fighting in Mogadishu | Conflict News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Somalia’s** federal government declared that order has been restored in Mogadishu after two days of fighting between government forces and opposition fighters. The violence, which began on Wednesday, subsided with the disarming of opposition militias and the return of civilians to their daily lives. **Hassan Sheikh Mohamud**, the incumbent president, says parliament lawfully extended his term, while the opposition has called it a power grab.  The UN refugee agency reported at least 13 deaths and 189 injuries. The fighting was sparked by disputes over elections and protests, with former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire and former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed leading opposition calls for demonstrations and timely elections. Despite the government’s claims of restored order, the opposition vows to continue their fight.

recent_articles.title: US adds 172,000 jobs in May, easing fears of labour market slowdown
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US** economy added 172,000 jobs in May, exceeding economists' expectations of 85,000. This robust performance suggests a resilient labor market despite geopolitical tensions and higher oil prices.  However, the gains are attributed to companies holding onto employees rather than aggressive hiring, driven by concerns about tariffs and uncertainty surrounding the US-Israeli war with Iran. The **Federal Reserve** is expected to maintain its key interest rate at current levels for the foreseeable future, keeping borrowing costs elevated despite a stable job market.

recent_articles.title: After Annamalai’s exit, Tamil Nadu BJP Vice President, senior leaders walk out of party | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K Annamalai**, former **BJP** president of **Tamil Nadu**, has resigned from the party, sparking a split in its state unit.  **Karu Nagarajan**, vice-president, and **Abhilash Gopinath**, BJP Yuva Morcha legal convener, have also resigned in support of Annamalai's new political movement. The former IPS officer aims to establish "common man politics," rejecting personality-driven politics and hereditary power.  Over 8.09 lakh people enrolled as volunteers on his newly launched platform, https://wetheleader.org/.

recent_articles.title: Celtic fans oppose Keane as potential manager after Israel role | Football News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Celtic** fans have expressed strong opposition to the potential appointment of **Robbie Keane** as manager, citing his previous role with **Maccabi Tel Aviv**.  The club's pro-Palestinian supporters are angered by Keane's decision to stay in Israel during the conflict in Gaza. A group called "Celtic Fans for the Liberation of Palestine" has issued a statement opposing the appointment, arguing that Keane's move was insensitive and divisive. The group claims his decision is incompatible with Celtic's history of solidarity with Palestinians.

recent_articles.title: Only 8 MLAs, 6 MPs At Mamata Banerjee's Home For Key Meet. Party Clarifies
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Only eight **Trinamool Congress** MLAs attended a National Working Committee meeting at former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee's Kalighat house in Kolkata, following a rebellion within the party.  The party clarified that not all MPs and MLAs were invited, with only four Lok Sabha MPs and two Rajya Sabha MPs present. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata Banerjee's nephew, was among those who attended. Rebel MLA **Ritabrata Banerjee** stated that more MLAs will join the rebellion, increasing the number of supporters beyond 2/3rd of the party.

recent_articles.title: WHO, Africa CDC unveil $518m Ebola plan as Uganda death toll rises | Ebola News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **WHO** and the **Africa CDC** have announced a $518 million plan to combat the Ebola outbreak in **DRC** and neighboring Uganda. The initiative, running from June to November, will focus on emergency coordination, surveillance, testing, infection prevention, clinical care, and community engagement.  The outbreak has spread from **DRC**, infecting at least 381 people and causing 64 deaths. In Uganda, the total number of cases has risen to 19 with two deaths. The rare Bundibugyo strain is believed to have been spreading undetected for some time.

recent_articles.title: 2027 UP Assembly Elections: Decoding UP's Political Battle: Can BJP Counter Akhilesh Yadav Samajwadi's PDA Formula?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The political landscape of Uttar Pradesh is shifting as parties prepare for the 2027 Assembly elections. The **Samajwadi Party** (SP) is attempting to broaden its appeal beyond the Muslim-Yadav base with a "PDA" formula targeting OBCs, Dalits, and minorities.  The **BJP**, meanwhile, is focusing on non-Yadav OBCs and other key social groups through strong leadership and Hindutva messaging. The SP's efforts are facing challenges from internal contradictions within the PDA coalition and concerns raised by leaders like **Om Prakash Rajbhar** of the SBSP who argue for greater representation within the party.  The BJP, with its focus on Hindu consolidation, is seen as having a structural advantage in this caste-based battle.

recent_articles.title: Trump Sees Win As US Senate Approves $70 Billion For Immigration Crackdown
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US Senate** approved $70 billion in funding for Donald Trump's hardline immigration crackdown, marking a victory for the Republican leader. The bill, which funds Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Border Patrol through the remainder of Trump's term, passed after a contentious vote-a-rama process that highlighted internal Republican divisions.  The legislation now heads to the **House of Representatives**, where Republicans hope to move it quickly to President Trump's desk.
